mapper.sql: select r.id, r.student_id, r.category, r.title, r.content, r.occurred_on, r.status, r.feedback, prior.previous_id, next_revision.replacement_id as replaced_by from student_growth_submission r left join student_growth_revision prior on prior.replacement_id = r.id left join student_growth_revision next_revision on next_revision.previous_id = r.id
mapper.select: select id from student where id = #{studentId} for update
select id, subject, exam_name, score, full_score, occurred_on from score_record where student_id = #{studentId} and occurred_on between #{start} and #{end} order by occurred_on, id

select period_start, period_end, moral_score, skill_score, thinking_score, smart_score, evidence from dimension_evaluation where student_id = #{studentId} and period_end between #{start} and #{end} order by period_end desc
select id, skill_name, score, level, occurred_on, evidence from skill_record where student_id = #{studentId} and occurred_on between #{start} and #{end} order by occurred_on desc, id desc
select id, activity_date, activity_type, detail from activity_record where student_id = #{studentId} and activity_date between #{start} and #{end} order by activity_date desc, id desc
where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.occurred_on between #{start} and #{end} order by r.occurred_on desc, r.id desc
where r.student_id = #{studentId} order by r.id desc
select previous_id from student_growth_revision where replacement_id = #{replacementId}
select status from student_growth_submission where id = #{id} and student_id = #{studentId}
select count(*) from student_growth_revision where previous_id = #{previousId}
mapper.insert: insert into student_growth_submission(student_id, request_key, category, title, content, occurred_on) values (#{studentId}, #{requestKey}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{occurredOn})
mapper.select: join student s on s.id = r.student_id join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where r.id = #{id} and c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into activity_record(student_id, activity_date, activity_type, status, detail, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{activityDate}, #{activityType}, #{status}, #{detail}, #{createdBy})
